links.title: Chapter 21 - Making Graphs and Manipulating Images, Automate the Boring Stuff with Python, 3rd Ed
links.why: The course textbook's own chapter, free online: colors and coordinates, Pillow, Project 16, ImageDraw, the clipboard and Matplotlib.

links.title: Image module - Pillow (PIL Fork) 12.3.0 documentation
links.why: Every Image method of the chapter with its exact signature: open, new, crop, paste, resize, rotate, transpose, thumbnail and save.

links.title: ImageColor module - Pillow (PIL Fork) 12.3.0 documentation
links.why: The color strings Pillow accepts: hex forms, rgb(), hsl() and the case-insensitive color names.

links.title: ImageDraw module - Pillow (PIL Fork) 12.3.0 documentation
links.why: point, line, rectangle, ellipse, polygon and text, including that a rectangle's bounding box is inclusive of both endpoints.

links.title: ImageFont module - Pillow (PIL Fork) 12.3.0 documentation
links.why: truetype and load_default, and the unit of a font size.

links.title: Tutorial - Pillow (PIL Fork) 12.3.0 documentation
links.why: Pillow's own walk through opening, cropping, pasting, resizing and rotating images.

links.title: matplotlib.pyplot.pie - Matplotlib 3.11.2 documentation
links.why: The pie chart function, its autopct argument, and the note that since 3.11 it returns a PieContainer.

links.title: matplotlib.pyplot.show - Matplotlib 3.11.2 documentation
links.why: What show does, when it blocks, and the order of savefig and show.

links.title: matplotlib.pyplot.savefig - Matplotlib 3.11.2 documentation
links.why: Saving the current figure to a file or a file-like object, with its dpi and format arguments.

links.title: Matplotlib Application Interfaces (APIs) - Matplotlib 3.11.2 documentation
links.why: The explicit Axes interface and the implicit pyplot interface that keeps track of the current figure.

links.title: pyperclipimg - copy and paste images on the clipboard (README)
links.why: The clipboard package of the chapter: its operating-system requirements and the copy and paste functions.

links.title: os - Miscellaneous operating system interfaces - Python 3.14 documentation
links.why: listdir, makedirs and walk, used by the logo program and the photo folder exercise; listdir returns names in arbitrary order.

links.title: Portable Network Graphics (PNG) Specification (Third Edition)
links.why: The file signature and the IHDR chunk that holds an image's width and height.

_note: Every url was opened with an HTTP fetch and its content read on the date in 'checked'; titles are those of the pages, the Matplotlib pages being 3.11.2, the Pillow pages 12.3.0 and the Python page headed 3.14.8 when served. The pyperclipimg page on pypi.org was not readable (it answered with a browser challenge), so its README on GitHub is listed. No video, discussion thread or interactive tool is listed: none was opened and read.
